messages.content: What year was the law of universal gravitation published by Isaac Newton?

function.name: publication_year_find
function.description: Fetches the year a particular scientific work was published. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

author.description: Name of the author of the work.

location.description: Place of the publication, if known. Default to 'all'.

message.reasoning:
We need to answer: "What year was the law of universal gravitation published by Isaac Newton?" The user asks about the year Newton published the law of universal gravitation. We should provide the year. According to history, Newton's Principia Mathematica (Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy) was first published in 1687. That contains his law of universal gravitation. So answer: 1687.

But we might want to confirm via the tool. The tool can fetch publication year given author and work title. Let's use it. We'll call functions.publication_year_find with author "Isaac Newton" and work_title "Principia Mathematica". But the question: "law of universal gravitation" is not a specific work title; but we know it's in Principia. The tool expects a work title. We could pass "Principia Mathematica". Let's do that.
